g.title: j217710203
g.text: All right. Gotta finally ask. What's up with the photography?

g.title: j1466428778
g.text: What did you want to do? Back before... all this happened?

g.title: j118870973
g.text: ur boi cant have hobbies? everybody got hobbies, m8 lol

g.title: j4010271832
g.text: eeeh i dunno if a man like me ever gets 2 really have dreams 4 the future, m8

g.title: j2416366488
g.text: I just really love some of the pictures you've taken. They're gorgeous work.

g.title: j3988518164
g.text: I'm just really curious.

g.title: j2783263832
g.text: its not really how life goes 4 ppl like me if u read me. i dreamed of bein' famous someday. of goin' home with fat stacks of Ps for nan and sis

g.title: j3813136245
g.text: I was wondering where you picked it up from, is all.

g.title: j1610548484
g.text: You just don't strike me as the photography type.

g.title: j3873685303
g.text: but now neither of those r gonna happen, r they? i'm here. we're here. loopin'. forever. or until something gets unstuck 'n things all fall apart, who knows

g.title: j30769630
g.text: my dad. when he died, we had all his stuff, yeah? lua don't let u take luggage

g.title: j2057422962
g.text: what i gotta be all street all the time?

g.title: j1810343620
g.text: You seem to be taking the whole "stuck here forever" thing well.

g.title: j2857719025
g.text: You haven't talked much about your family.

g.title: j2682148887
g.text: we sold everything of any decent value, ofc. gotta make the rent, cuz. but there were still some boxes of random stuff kickin' around

g.title: j3986549243
g.text: shit, cuz. see some depth will u?

g.title: j2345642586
g.text: can't fix it, y get bent outta shape? n we got things 2 do. n there are upsides

g.text: 1 day, when i was a kid, im rootin' thru a box n i find this lil neon green rectangular camera

g.text: i'm sure i'll get sick of it n loose my shit eventually but nah. 4 now i'm good. ur mans is tough

g.text: yeah i check in. they're ok. the techrot hasn't gotten out there yet. dunno if that changes thru the year or not. hope not

g.title: j44270601
g.text: yeah. course i do. but i haven't been home in a long time, cuz. long, long time. between the army, ICR, now this?

g.title: j2246305592
g.text: used 2 run round takin shots of EVERYTHING. drove my auntie NUTS lol! best time

g.title: j1153334173
g.text: yeh. we do. n ppl adapt, thats the thing, innit? no matter what. u drop bombs n ppl n they still like 'oop off 2 go buy bread doo de doo'

g.title: j3607584727
g.text: ppl adapt, thats the thing, innit? no matter what. u drop bombs n ppl n they still like 'oop off 2 go buy bread doo de doo'

g.title: j1526025199
g.text: miss them tons. still good 2 be able 2 hear their voices. im used 2 not being able to go home, since i haven't walked thru those doors 4 more than a holiday or 2 for yeeeeeaars

g.title: j1257543869
g.text: haven't walked thru those doors 4 more than just a holiday or 2 for yeeaaaaaaars

g.title: j3018376203
g.text: i guess i just got the bug then. ever since it's just a thing i like 2 do when i got the time. takes my mind off the job
